vPTXMzcqZkA.title: Redbird Willow Farm — Southern Legends
vPTXMzcqZkA.description:
The willow tree is still there.

Michele Hornsby's son Justin died by suicide on their property in 2017. She didn't leave. She planted a willow tree, drove to Oklahoma, and came home with a llama.

The llama was already named Justine. She took that as a sign.

There are 120 animals at Redbird Willow Farm now — and people come when they don't know where else to go.

📍 1103 Lenlock Lane, Anniston, AL | redbirdwillowfarm.com
If you're in crisis: call or text 988.

—

elr-TTjl7y8.title: Redbird Willow Farm — Southern Legends
elr-TTjl7y8.description:
In 2017, Michele Hornsby's son Justin died by suicide on their 38-acre property in Anniston, Alabama. What she built on that land — Redbird Willow Farm, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit with 120 animals — has become a place where grieving people come to breathe.

Directed by Matt Headley for Southern Legends. Narration by Matt Headley.
